stage: development-only diagnostic; not a new confirmation
plan: Freeze 240-development input IDs and Word hashes.
Test bounded full-page and tile-consensus translation on synthetic nuisances and local changes.
Compute raw and aligned pixel/blur residuals on fixed negative and positive conditions.
Calibrate thresholds on train folds only; evaluate paired out-of-fold detection, FPR by nuisance, class retention, and registration failures.
Inspect failures, check reusable licensed source candidates, publish allowlisted text artifacts under web-change only.
word_policy: FROZEN. No editing, overwriting, copying as a new version, or invoking taskbook writers without explicit user request.

word_reference.archive_path: protocol/网页截图的细微变更分类｜实验任务书_v1.1.docx

inputs.excluded: Historical155 and all 355 confirmation pairs and 72 confirmation controls. No data expansion.

registration_rules.rounding: nearest integer; outside allowed range rejected

residuals.pixel4: fraction of pixels with max RGB absolute difference >4
residuals.blur8: same fraction after 3x3 Gaussian blur sigma=.6 with difference threshold >8

shift: integer global shift with replicated border; JPEG before shift in combined condition

validation.group: original before-image proxy group; derived cases stay with original
validation.threshold: max of per-negative-condition .95 higher quantile on training folds; strict greater-than
validation.notes: Held-out fold FPR can exceed5%; report observed values. No claim of an unseen-site split.

bootstrap.scope: descriptive paired intervals conditional on fixed folds and calibrated thresholds; no selection-adjusted inference

scope_limits: Development OOF only; 355 already-unblinded confirmation examples untouched.
Synthetic nuisances are controlled approximations, not real browser regression gold standard.
A3 is a fixed preprocessing diagnostic, not an established innovation.
public_export_note: Machine-specific read-only Word guard paths omitted. Frozen Word version/hash retained. This is a development-only diagnostic, not a formal protocol change.
